subject: A consistent daily routine tracked less pain and better sleep
script: From Agewell Brief: A consistent daily routine tracked less pain and better sleep. New research from the University of Missouri suggests that sticking to a regular daily schedule could improve well-being, especially for older adults struggling with insomnia. A consistent daily routine may reduce physical pain. It may also ease symptoms of depression. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
